backstory.original: Born into the royal family of Celene, he assumed the simple name of Melf eschewing a life of comfort as a noble to study the arcane arts and train as a swordsman. He delved in the dungeons of Castle Greyhawk, the Lost Caverns of Tsojcanth and many other harrowing places honing his skills, knowledge and amassing powerful magical items. Melf sees himself as a weapon of weal hurtling toward the heart of the darkest evils in the realm. He is opinionated and has a touch of conceit that he is blissfully ignorant of possessing.
backstory.display: 出生在塞莱涅皇室，他取了个简单的名字马友夫。他放弃了贵族的安逸生活去学习奥术，训练自己成为了一名剑士。他行遍灰鹰堡的地下城、佐坎斯的迷失洞窟和其他许多痛苦之地，磨练自己的技能、知识，积攒强大的魔法物品。马友夫将自己看作是一件正义的武器，朝着王国最黑暗的邪恶中心急速前进。他很有主见，并且有一丝自负，但自己并不知晓这一点。

description.original: Melf leaps out and attacks the nearest enemy with his magic spear. If he has any Minute Meteors active, he fires one at a random enemy as well.
description.display: 马友夫跳起用他的魔法长矛攻击距离最近的敌人。如果他有激活的微流星，还会向一名随机敌人发射一颗。

longDescription.original: Melf leaps out and attacks the nearest enemy with his magic spear. If he has any Minute Meteors active, he fires one at a random enemy as well.
longDescription.display: 马友夫跳起用他的魔法长矛攻击距离最近的敌人。如果他有激活的微流星，还会向一名随机敌人发射一颗。

description.original: Melf summons six Minute Meteors that float around him. They are fired when he attacks normally and deal AOE BUD-based damage.
description.display: 马友夫召唤六个微流星漂浮在他身边。他进行普通攻击时微流星也会发动攻击，造成基于基础杀招伤害的范围伤害。

longDescription.original: Melf summons six Minute Meteors that float around him. They are fired when he attacks normally and deal AOE BUD-based damage.
longDescription.display: 马友夫召唤六个微流星漂浮在他身边。他进行普通攻击时微流星也会发动攻击，造成基于基础杀招伤害的范围伤害。

description.desc: Melf creates a custom spell to assist the formation. It increases the damage of adjacent Champions by $amount%, and will be augmented based on the specialization you pick for Melf.
马友夫自创一个定制的法术来辅助阵型。它会使相邻勇士的伤害提高 $amount%，并且会根据你为马友夫选择的专精强化。

tipText.original: Melf creates a customized support spell to buff adjacent Champions, and it is augmented based on the specializations you pick and his position in the formation.
tipText.display: 马友夫自创一个定制的支援法术来为相邻的勇士提供增益，并且该法术会根据你选择的专精和他在阵型中的位置而强化。

description.desc: Melf increases the range of Melf's Custom Support Spell by 2 and the effect of Melf's Custom Support Spell by $(amount___2)% if Melf is in the column in the formation with the most Champions. In the event of a formation with multiple columns of the same size, Melf can be in any of them.
如果马友夫身处阵型中勇士数量最多的那一列，那么马友夫会使“马友夫定制支援法术”的范围增加 2，“马友夫定制支援法术”的效果提高 $(amount___2)%。如果阵型中存在多列勇士数量相同，那么马友夫可身处其中的任意一列。
Unlocks Melf's Ultimate Attack - Melf's Minute Meteors
解锁马友夫的杀招：马友夫微流星

Melf knows exactly what evil is. Whenever an enemy spawns, or is attacked by Melf, it has a $(amount___2)% chance of being deemed "evil".  Enemies that are deemed evil take $amount% more damage from all attacks that deal BUD-based damage (such as Ultimate Attacks).
马友夫深知邪恶的本质。当一名敌人刷新或被马友夫攻击时，有 $(amount___2) 的几率被视为“邪恶”。被视为邪恶的敌人在遭到会造成基于基础杀招伤害的伤害的攻击（例如杀招攻击）时，会额外受到 $amount% 的伤害。

Melf magically causes an additional enemy to spawn with each wave $amount% of the time. If there are any Champions in the formation with a Favored Foe, the enemy spawned will be a random Champion's Favored Foe.
马友夫神奇地使每波有 $amount% 的几率额外刷新一名敌人。如果阵型中有勇士有偏好对手，那么刷新的敌人将是随机一位勇士的偏好对手。

specializationDescription.original: Melf causes more foes to spawn, and those foes will be Favored Foes if possible.
specializationDescription.display: 马友夫会使更多敌人刷新出来，而且如有可能，这些敌人将是偏好对手。

tipText.original: Melf has chosen to increase the number of foes spawning, and they will be favored foes if possible.
tipText.display: 马友夫选择增加敌人刷新的数量，而且如有可能，刷新的敌人将是偏好对手。

description.desc: Melf magically increases enemy spawn speed by $amount%, and Melf's Righteous Determination "evil" chance is increased by 25% additively (to a 75% chance).
马友夫神奇地使敌人的刷新速度提高 $amount%，并且“马友夫的正义决心”判定为“邪恶”的几率以加算方式提高 25%（提高为 75%）。

specializationDescription.original: Melf causes foes to spawn faster and is more likely to deem them as "evil".
specializationDescription.display: 马友夫会使敌人刷新得更快，而且更有可能将他们视为“邪恶”。

tipText.original: Melf has chosen to make foes spawn faster and be more likely to deem them as "evil".
tipText.display: 马友夫选择加快敌人刷新的速度，而且更有可能将他们视为“邪恶”。

description.desc: Melf magically increases the chance that an enemy will drop double quest items or count for two kills by $chance%.
马友夫神奇地使一名敌人掉落双倍任务物品或被计作两次击杀的几率提高 $chance%。

specializationDescription.original: Melf magically increases the quest rewards of defeated enemies.
specializationDescription.display: 马友夫神奇地增加被击败敌人的任务奖励。

tipText.original: Melf causes faster quest progress to happen when defeating enemies.
tipText.display: 马友夫会增加击败敌人时获得的任务进度。

description.desc: Melf counts the most populous species among other Champions in the formation. Melf's Custom Support Spell is increased by $(amount)% for each Champion of that species in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. If tied, all tied species count.
马友夫统计阵型里其他勇士当中人数最多的种族。阵型中每有一位该种族的勇士，“马友夫定制支援法术”效果提高 $(amount)%。若存在并列，则将所有并列的种族计算在内。

specializationDescription.original: Melf's main buff increases based on the most populous species in his formation.
specializationDescription.display: 马友夫的主要增益会根据阵型中人数最多的种族而提升。

description.desc: Melf counts the most popular attack type among other Champions in the formation. Melf's Custom Support Spell is increased by $(amount)% for each Champion in the formation with that type, stacking multiplicatively, and Melf changes his attack to match. If tied, all tied attack types count.
马友夫统计阵型里其他勇士当中最多人采用的攻击类型。马友夫自己的攻击类型变为该类型，并且阵型中每有一位采用该类型的勇士，“马友夫定制支援法术”效果提高 $(amount)%。若存在并列，则将所有并列的攻击类型计算在内。

specializationDescription.original: Melf's main buff increases depending on the number of the most represented attack type of other Champions: melee, ranged, or magic.
specializationDescription.display: 马友夫的主要增益会根据其他勇士最具代表性攻击类型（近战、远程或魔法）的数量而提升。

description.desc: Melf counts the most represented non-Support Role among the other Champions in the formation. Melf's Custom Support Spell is increased by $(amount)% for each Champion in the formation with that role, stacking multiplicatively, and Melf gains the Role. If tied, all tied Roles count.
马友夫统计阵型里其他勇士当中最具代表性的非支援角色定位。马友夫获得该角色定位，并且阵型中每有一位拥有该角色定位的勇士，“马友夫定制支援法术”效果提高 $(amount)%。若存在并列，则将所有并列的角色定位计算在内。

specializationDescription.original: Melf's main buff increases depending on the number of other Champions with the most represented non-Support role in the formation.
specializationDescription.display: 马友夫的主要增益会根据阵型中拥有最具代表性非支援角色定位的其他勇士数量而提升。

description.desc: Melf counts the most represented alignment on the Lawful/Chaotic axis among the other Champions in the formation. Melf's Custom Support Spell is increased by $(amount)% for each Champion in the formation with that alignment, stacking multiplicatively, and Melf gains the alignment. If tied, all tied alignments count.
马友夫统计阵型里其他勇士当中最具代表性的阵营（以守序/混乱划分）。马友夫变为该阵营，并且阵型中每有一位该阵营的勇士，“马友夫定制支援法术”效果提高 $(amount)%。若存在并列，则将所有并列的阵营计算在内。

specializationDescription.original: Melf's main buff increases depending on the number of other Champions with the most represented alignment on the law/chaos axis in the formation.
specializationDescription.display: 马友夫的主要增益会根据阵型中最具代表性阵营（以守序/混乱划分）的其他勇士数量而提升。

description.original: Prince Brightflame is nothing if not selfless!
description.display: 光焰王子如果不够无私，他就一无是处！

description.original: Yes, I am.
description.display: 是的，我是。

description.original: Rally to me, friends. We will survive this, and glory shall be ours.
description.display: 向我靠拢，朋友们！我们会挺过去的，荣耀属于我们。

description.original: I've got your back, as long as you've got mine.
description.display: 只要你掩护我，我就会掩护你。

description.original: I've trained many mages, though never so many at once!
description.display: 我训练过很多法师，但从来没有同时训练过这么多！

description.original: Stick with me, and we'll probably make it out alive.
description.display: 跟紧我，我们联手或许能够活着离开这个地方。

description.original: Step aside, friend. I need to be where everyone can hear me.
description.display: 让开，朋友。我得到所有人都能听见我说话的地方去。

description.original: Weapons, at the ready! We charge them together as one!
description.display: 准备好武器！我们团结一心，向他们发动冲锋！

description.original: Yes, yes. We'll get there in time. Don't worry so much!
description.display: 是的，是的，我们会准时到达。别太担心！

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's first set of Specializations by 40%

description.original: You can't just leave them in the box, can you?
description.display: 不能就这么放在盒子里吧？

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's first set of Specializations by 80%

description.original: That one looks evil.
description.display: 那家伙看上去挺邪恶的。

description.original: They won't be snickering for long.
description.display: 他们不会得意太久了。

description.original: You've heard the tales, now watch me work.
description.display: 你们应该听过传说了，下面就来看我实际演示一下。

description.original: I've lived long enough to know how to adapt to any situation as needed.
description.display: 我活了这么久，知道怎样随机应变。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's second set of Specializations by 40%

description.original: With every step, every breath, I strive to create a better world for all.
description.display: 每一次迈步、每一口呼吸，我都在努力为所有人创造一个更美好的世界。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's second set of Specializations by 80%

description.original: You're either with me, or you oppose all that is right and good. Which shall it be?
description.display: 你要么站在我这边，要么反对一切正义和善良。你怎么选？

effects.description: Increases the damage of all Champions by 20% for each unique species in the formation, stacking additively.

name.display: 自命不凡的魔术师马友夫

description.original: A spear I found in the lost caverns. No not Tsojcanth, just your everyday type.
description.display: 这是我在失落洞穴中找到的长矛。不，并不是索吉卡斯失落洞窟，就只是很普通的洞穴。

description.original: It's good for solo adventuring and I can keep my off hand free for somatic gestures.
description.display: 适合单独行动时使用，这样我空闲出来的另一只手就可以施展施法姿势了。

description.original: It's good to have standoff from your enemies, and it doubles as a 10-foot pole.
description.display: 适合抵御一群敌人，因为你可以把它当作十尺长杆用。

description.original: This powerful item can shrink to the size of a needle or grow as long as a polearm.
description.display: 此魔法物品可以缩小成细针，也可膨胀成长枪。

description.original: A seasoned adventurer needs few things, but a shield is one of them.
description.display: 经验丰富的冒险者并不需要太多的装备，但盾牌绝对是必备品之一。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's second set of Specializations by $amount%

description.original: It heralds my arrival, heartening the forces of weal and forewarning my foes of their doom.
description.display: 此盾宣告着我的降临，既能振奋友军的军心，亦能瓦解敌人的斗志。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's second set of Specializations by $amount%

description.original: This symbol is known throughout the Kingdom of Celene.
description.display: 此徽记在赛琳王国是家喻户晓的标志。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's second set of Specializations by $amount%

description.original: Melf is a simple name, as good as any. I let my deeds speak for me.
description.display: 马友夫是个很普通的名字。我会用我的行动来证明自己。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's second set of Specializations by $amount%

description.original: I thought it was near the entrance, but now I can't find it!
description.display: 我记得是放在门口边的，但现在却找不到了！

description.original: Here I am. Or am I here?
description.display: 我在这。或者是在这？

description.original: For when you need a quick exit.
description.display: 在需要迅速撤退时会用到。

description.original: It hides my true power beneath its sinuous layers.
description.display: 把我真实的力量隐藏在错综复杂的面纱下。

description.original: They always have the most complex spells.
description.display: 这种魔法书往往记录着最复杂的法术。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's first set of Specializations by $amount%

description.original: Weapon speed factors? Yes. I believe there is a reference here.
description.display: 武器速度因数？对。这里头似乎有相关记载。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's first set of Specializations by $amount%

description.original: It's got a rare gem every few pages, but it's mostly old hat.
description.display: 每翻几页就会出现珍贵的宝石，不过其余大部分都是陈旧的帽子。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's first set of Specializations by $amount%

description.original: Evil is always working to destroy and create chaos. I stand to stop it.
description.display: 邪恶总会寻找就会制造混乱与破坏。我的使命就是阻挡他们。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Melf's first set of Specializations by $amount%

description.original: Best if combined with mage armor.
description.display: 最适合搭配法师护甲一起穿。

description.original: My father gave it to me long ago. It's quite patched, but it's still in good order.
description.display: 这是很久以前父亲给我的。虽然缝补过，但整体状态还是可以的。

description.original: I prefer to be long gone before an enemy is close enough.
description.display: 我比较喜欢远距离杀伤敌人。

name.display: 马友夫的精灵族锁子甲

description.original: Thin, light, and ever so quiet. Perfect for a grey elf like myself.
description.display: 单薄、轻盈、悄无声息。简直是我这种灰精灵的绝配。

description.original: Don't be fooled by the name.
description.display: 不要被名字中的小给误导了。

description.original: Hey, did anyone see those gnolls?
description.display: 咦，有人看到那些豺狼人吗？

description.original: If you study hard kids, you too can unlock latent magical power!
description.display: 只要功夫深，你们也能觉醒强大的魔法力量的！

description.original: Watch out. This one goes BOOM.
description.display: 当心了。这次可是会爆炸的。

Increases the damage of all Champions by $(amount)% for each Male Champion in the formation
